verdict.rationale: Meltano ships a well-documented, scriptable CLI covering project init, plugin management, config testing, and pipeline orchestration, with idempotent commands suitable for automation by AI agents (meltano-docs-33, meltano-docs-24, meltano-probe-3). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of AI-agent-specific usage patterns (e.g., machine-readable output modes, MCP/agent SDK bindings) or independent hands-on confirmation of agentic use.
